title: Create and Stuffs
description: This modpack consists of create and some of its additions. It also is rather well optimised but has shaders for anyone who wants them. Also contains qol mods.
body: This modpacks has many qol and optimisation mods along with create and it's additions. It was mainly made for a small group of friends or singleplayer. There are also subtle additions to biomes and new enchantmens to explore. For a server installation, it is recommended and possibly even required to remove any clientside mods before starting the server as it may give a crash.
